amendment_reason: The v1 auxiliary prime 7 certifies 16 of 20 rows; an exploratory exact search found prime 11 for the remaining four. Preserve v1 and test the fixed ordered prime list [7,11] on every archived accepted row.
population: all 1722 frozen ordered pairs with all 20 admitted rows retained
certificate_rule: For each admitted rational curve and ordered pair, take the first prime in the fixed list with good reduction, integral point coordinates, and pair classes independent in E(F_l)/2E(F_l). Exact criterion: P, Q, and P+Q each lie outside the doubled-point set 2E(F_l).
torsion_rule: Enumerate rational roots of x^3+A*x+B for every distinct admitted curve; an empty list certifies no rational 2-torsion on the short Weierstrass model.
falsifier: An admitted row with neither prime satisfying the quotient criterion, or a curve with a rational cubic root, remains uncertified and is reported without substitution.
proof_goal: Apply the checked abstract mod-2 reduction and infinite-descent theorem to every row with a certificate; actual curve and reduction maps remain an explicit formalization bridge.
measurement: exact correctness census, no performance comparison
run_cap: one pass over the 1722 archived rows; E(F7) and E(F11) enumerated exactly for each of 20 admitted rows
